commands.name: train
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.train_ppo --config configs/ppo_m88_wheel_masked_friction_aux_driver.json --total-steps 4096 --rollout-steps 64 --num-envs 4 --vector-env-mode sync --seed 4290 --device cuda --init-checkpoint runs/m89_wheel_masked_friction_objective_only_seed9200/optimized_checkpoint.pt --run-dir runs/ppo_m90_guarded_wheel_objective_smoke_seed4290 --eval-episodes 4

commands.name: ablation_gate
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.benchmark --env-config configs/ppo_m88_wheel_masked_friction_aux_driver.json --episodes 20 --seed 8830 --policies heuristic --checkpoint-policy m90=runs/ppo_m90_guarded_wheel_objective_smoke_seed4290/checkpoint.pt --checkpoint-policy m90_zero_wheel=runs/ppo_m90_guarded_wheel_objective_smoke_seed4290/checkpoint.pt@zero_wheel_response --checkpoint-policy m90_reset=runs/ppo_m90_guarded_wheel_objective_smoke_seed4290/checkpoint.pt@reset_recurrent_state --checkpoint-policy m90_zero_all=runs/ppo_m90_guarded_wheel_objective_smoke_seed4290/checkpoint.pt@zero_all_response --device cpu --run-dir runs/m90_guarded_wheel_objective_gate_seed8830

commands.name: relevance_audit
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.wheel_response_relevance_audit --checkpoint runs/ppo_m90_guarded_wheel_objective_smoke_seed4290/checkpoint.pt --env-config configs/ppo_m88_wheel_masked_friction_aux_driver.json --episodes 30 --seed 9100 --device cpu --max-samples 1500 --epochs 120 --run-dir runs/m90_guarded_wheel_objective_relevance_audit_seed9100

decision_rule: Accept as a continuation candidate only if aggregate success is at least 0.85, zero-wheel success is at least 0.10 below normal success, reset is not better than normal, and mu body+wheel gain remains at least 0.10. Otherwise reject and move to matched wrong-wheel-history corpus.
failure_criteria: clearance margin regresses below the M89 same-seed gate
training fails to produce checkpoint and gate artifacts
hypothesis: Guarded PPO continuation from the M89 objective-only wheel-aware checkpoint can preserve driving behavior while increasing causal dependence on wheel response.
success_criteria: normal success_rate >= 0.85 on the 20-episode same-seed gate
no hidden parameters or oracle labels are added to actor observations
